replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics isn't my favorite subject; I prefer chemistry and biology. It feels dry and abstract compared to those sciences. However, I acknowledge its importance in many fields. As someone detail-oriented and high in conscientiousness, I respect its logic but find the creative aspects of literature or the tangible experiments in my hobbies more engaging. I see it as a necessary tool rather than a passion.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes. With moderate neuroticism, complex numbers or abstract proofs trigger some anxiety. I tend to worry about making mistakes or not understanding quickly enough. Yet, my high conscientiousness helps me work through it methodically. I prefer breaking tasks into small, manageable steps rather than facing large, overwhelming mathematical concepts all at once.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I haven't used AI extensively for math recently. I prefer traditional study methods like textbooks or asking professors in person. However, I have used it for general information gathering. My experience was mixed; while it explained concepts clearly, I felt it lacked the personal nuance of a human tutor. I value the direct interaction more than quick digital answers.
